args.body: Hi Eve! I just visited your blog at www.eve-blog.com and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you highlight your favorite hobby, hiking — it gives the blog a personal touch right away. A few suggestions: consider adding more posts about your hiking adventures, some photos from your favorite trails, and maybe tips or gear recommendations for fellow hikers. Expanding the content would make your blog more engaging and give readers more to explore. Keep up the great work!

Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some feedback. I like how clean and simple it is — it's easy to read and gets straight to the point. A few suggestions to make it even better: consider adding a short bio or introduction about yourself, some details on your projects, skills, or interests, and maybe a few links to your work or social profiles. This would give visitors a fuller picture of who you are. Overall, a nice and tidy personal site — keep it up!
